reference: FFmpeg 9.0.1; distinct PCM16 channel signals; WAV masks, MOV chan and MP4 chnl. ISO speaker positions follow version 9; version 7 uses incompatible side-channel positions and predefined ordering. The existing 5.1.4 display name is retained from native 7; native 9 spells the same mask as 10 channels (FL+FR+FC+LFE+BL+BR+TFL+TFR+TBL+TBR).
